fsspec_blockcache_implementation.framework: fs = earthaccess.get_fsspec_https_session(); fs.open(data_url, mode='rb', cache_type='blockcache', block_size=8388608)
fsspec_blockcache_implementation.integration_correction: Replaced detached fsspec.filesystem('https') with earthaccess.get_fsspec_https_session() ensuring OAuth Bearer tokens are carried directly into the remote file handle.
fsspec_blockcache_implementation.cache_validation_protocol: Instrumented cache_info() tracking hits, misses, and currsize. Gated with a targeted repeat read to explicitly demonstrate block reuse in RAM without redundant network fetches.
numerical_validation_criteria: HTTP 206 Partial Content and binary HDF5 signature
HHHH array: 100x100 real, finite values (finite_ratio, min, max, mean, dB)
Mask layer: distribution of 0 (invalid/partial), 1..N (valid), and 255 (nodata) per JPL D-102274
Cache proof: misses correspond to HTTP fetches, hits prove RAM block reuse
Visual preview: 2-panel backscatter and mask plots

values_definition.value_0: INVALID / PARTIALLY FOCUSED SAMPLE (assigned if any multi-look sample is incomplete or uncalibrated)
values_definition.values_1_to_N: VALID SAMPLE (indicates the subswath number, e.g. 1 = subswath 1, 2 = subswath 2)
values_definition.value_255: NO DATA / OUT OF SWATH / FILL VALUE (pixels falling outside the active radar beam)

gcov_mask_definitions_audit.critical_correction: mask == 0 is NOT valid data; it designates invalid or partially focused radar samples. Assuming mask == 0 meant valid was inverted.

spatial_grid_and_georeferencing_measured.pixel_convention: NISAR HDF5 xCoordinates/yCoordinates vectors record pixel centers. GeoTIFF Affine transform requires the top-left pixel corner (ul_x = x_center - dx/2, ul_y = y_center - dy/2).
